SELECT mps.*, m.material_name, m.material_spec, m.package_capacity, m.package_capacity_unit FROM mis_pricing_strategy mps LEFT JOIN mis_material m ON m.is_package = '1' AND mps.package_item_id = m.id WHERE mps.is_active = '1' AND mps.del_flag = '0' AND CURDATE() BETWEEN mps.effective_from AND mps.effective_to
AND ( #{entity.customer_id} IS NULL OR mps.customer_id = #{entity.customer_id} OR mps.customer_id IS NULL ) AND ( #{entity.salesman_id} IS NULL OR mps.salesman_id = #{entity.salesman_id} OR mps.salesman_id IS NULL ) AND ( #{entity.package_item_id} IS NULL OR mps.package_item_id = #{entity.package_item_id} OR mps.package_item_id IS NULL )
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM mis_pricing_strategy mps2 WHERE mps2.item_code = mps.item_code AND mps2.is_active = '1' AND mps2.del_flag = '0' AND CURDATE() BETWEEN mps2.effective_from AND mps2.effective_to
AND ( #{entity.customer_id} IS NULL OR mps2.customer_id = #{entity.customer_id} OR mps2.customer_id IS NULL ) AND ( #{entity.salesman_id} IS NULL OR mps2.salesman_id = #{entity.salesman_id} OR mps2.salesman_id IS NULL ) AND ( #{entity.package_item_id} IS NULL OR mps2.package_item_id = #{entity.package_item_id} OR mps2.package_item_id IS NULL )
AND ( ( (CASE WHEN #{entity.customer_id} IS NOT NULL AND mps2.customer_id = #{entity.customer_id} THEN 100 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN #{entity.salesman_id} IS NOT NULL AND mps2.salesman_id = #{entity.salesman_id} THEN 10 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN #{entity.package_item_id} IS NOT NULL AND mps2.package_item_id = #{entity.package_item_id} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ) > ( (CASE WHEN #{entity.customer_id} IS NOT NULL AND mps.customer_id = #{entity.customer_id} THEN 100 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN #{entity.salesman_id} IS NOT NULL AND mps.salesman_id = #{entity.salesman_id} THEN 10 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN #{entity.package_item_id} IS NOT NULL AND mps.package_item_id = #{entity.package_item_id} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ) OR ( -- 同分比时间 ( ... 同上打分相等 ... ) AND mps2.create_time > mps.create_time ) ) ) ORDER BY mps.create_time DESC
